Contract ManageStoreCRUDService::createStore(id: Integer,name: String,address: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		matchingStores: Set(Store) = Store.allInstance()->select(s|s.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		address.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		isopened.oclIsTypeOf(Boolean)
	postcondition:
		let ok: Boolean = true in
		if matchingStores.isEmpty() 
		then let newStore: Store in
		newStore.oclIsNew() and
		Store.allInstance()->includes(newStore) and
		newStore.Id = id and
		newStore.Name = name and
		newStore.Address = address and
		newStore.IsOpened = isopened and
		result = ok 
		else result = ok 
		endif 
}
